name: conlang-og
description: Source for the homepage og:video link preview (public/og-video.mp4) and its still (public/og-image.png).

scripts.render: remotion render OgVideo out/raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=1 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/raw.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset veryslow -tune animation -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v high -movflags +faststart -an ../public/og-video.mp4 && remotion still OgVideo ../public/og-image.png --frame=225 && (command -v oxipng >/dev/null && oxipng -o 4 --strip safe -q ../public/og-image.png || true)
